ci_feasibility_and_false_green_risks.summary: Today zero performance benchmarks execute in CI; all perf numbers come from opt-in local tools and one-off task evidence.

per_tool.false_green_risk: 50 ms bounds sit ~20x above observed worst p99, so gross regressions could still pass; conversely tight bounds would false-red on shared runners; debug-no-ndebug config differs from release intuition
verify gates semantics only; a 10x slowdown would stay green if digests match
high if misused as perf gate: adaptiveTimeoutMs deliberately absorbs load-induced delays up to 1.75x; lag metrics measure the harness process
survival-only verdict passes slow leaks and degradations; missing artifact provenance weakens auditability; retry masking already structurally rejected by TASK-0140 validator
headless software rendering timings neither bound owner-GPU behavior nor reproduce locally; both false directions likely
absent entirely: leaks and bloat are invisible to every existing gate (pm2 restart limit is an ops backstop, not evidence)
